audience: Fresh agent continuing a GitHub-tracked task
problem: Research notes can repeat claims while obscuring which supplied source supports each claim and when the record was changed.
solution: Provide a mostly deterministic, JEV-only semantic classification path and structured records that expose evidence pointers, epistemic status, lineage, and time fields.
mechanism: Bounded non-JEV source capture produces untrusted transcripts.
One supplied fragment and a closed label set are sent through TypeSafe JEV Decisions.
Python validates answers and records claim fields.
A deterministic consolidator groups already-formed claims by explicit topic and preserves disagreement.
A deterministic template renders six required Markdown sections and may add a Synthesis section from supplied topic records.

evidence.claim: The source collector captures bounded Grok research responses as untrusted source material.
evidence.supports: The module preserves the requested and surfaced model, transcript, citation annotations, request settings, and content hash without assigning claim labels.
evidence.limits: A recorded live provider smoke returned HTTP 404; successful live collection is not verified.

source_revision.locator: source-only module contract and artifact assembly

evidence.claim: The implemented classifier path sends one supplied fragment to the TypeSafe JEV Decisions client and validates a closed choice.
evidence.supports: The code builds a question from the fragment's closed labels and criteria, calls Decisions, and rejects malformed or out-of-set answers.
evidence.limits: The path is per-fragment; surfaced model identity is not checked against the request end to end, and this code does not establish paper-level accuracy.

evidence.claim: Answer normalization supports choice, score, and noul.
evidence.supports: The module validates closed choices, ordered-rubric score levels and surfaced legends, and yes/no probability values while preserving native probabilities.
evidence.limits: A valid score is a normalized JEV response, not a measure of paper-level summary accuracy.

evidence.claim: The assembler renders six required Markdown sections and an optional Synthesis section from supplied topic records.
evidence.supports: It renders Title, Abstract, Claims, Provenance, Lineage, and Citations; when topic records are supplied, it also renders their deterministic summary in a Synthesis section.
evidence.limits: It does not write narrative research prose, select topics, verify citation support, or guarantee preservation of every caveat.

evidence.claim: The consolidator deterministically groups already-formed claim records by explicit topic and preserves agreement, conflict, and temporal status.
evidence.supports: The code groups validated records by their explicit about value, requires an evaluation time, preserves conflicting live labels, and can render the resulting topic records.
evidence.limits: It does not extract claims or infer topics from raw transcripts; source ingestion and claim formation remain separate steps.

evidence.claim: The checked-in multi-source workflow is exercised with synthetic fragments and mocked JEV answers.
evidence.supports: The test checks a two-fragment example through the prototype claim and draft-assembly path.
evidence.limits: The example is synthetic; it does not measure quality on real papers or live model outputs.

evidence.claim: Ten candidate papers and a deterministic claim metric are selected and recorded; the reverse-analysis and holdout evaluation remain incomplete.
evidence.source: Owner-directed quality program in GitHub issue #21.
evidence.supports: The repository records ten candidate papers and claim_metric_v1; issue #21 retains the goals for at least ten reverse-analyzed papers, 30 qualifying iterations, and 0.80 claim-level F1 on a hidden paper-level holdout.
evidence.limits: Paper annotations, iteration count, and holdout performance have not been completed or measured; the F1 threshold is a target.

evidence.claim: One capped live provider smoke returned HTTP 404 and produced no live artifact.
evidence.supports: The completion record states that the single capped smoke returned HTTP 404, was not retried, and yielded no live artifact.
evidence.limits: This does not establish the cause of the response or current provider availability.

source_revision.reference: GitHub issue #15 completion checkpoint for Grok source capture
source_revision.locator: Issue #15 completion comment, capped live-smoke result

evidence.claim: Small claim-type and contradiction fixtures are generated deterministically from hand-authored synthetic samples.
evidence.supports: The dataset card identifies the committed fixture files, label-shape sources, hashes, and generator; the source revision contains the generator and matching tests.
evidence.limits: The samples are synthetic, contain no upstream corpus text, and are not benchmark items or performance evidence.

source_revision.locator: Committed fixture inventory, limitations, and deterministic generator record

boundaries: Only TypeSafe JEV may supply semantic classifier judgments that enter claim records.
Grok or another research model supplies untrusted source text only; source capture is not automatically classification.
The classifier handles one fragment per call; multi-source tests use synthetic fixtures and mocked responses.
The assembler creates a structural draft, not narrative research synthesis or citation support verification.

The legacy M5 record path does not enforce surfaced model identity end to end, parse timestamp order, or resolve its evidence references; M8 and the reference-graph module provide narrower bitemporal, span, and link checks. SHACL validation and full OWL2 reasoning remain incomplete.

Ten candidate papers and the metric harness are available, but paper annotations, an actual frozen holdout evaluation, thirty qualifying iterations, and measured paper-level accuracy remain outstanding.

preferred.source transcript: untrusted captured research text and citation annotations
preferred.claim record: typed record for one classified fragment
